about: Further reading for reading mode. Pointers only: a book, where in it to look, and one line in monochord's own words about what the book covers there. Never a quotation, never what the book says a symbol means. Not part of the graph, not in its content hash, and never a source for a pitch, a figure or a programme note. Every locus was drafted from memory and is checked: false until someone confirms it against a copy.

works.author: Austin Coppock
works.title: 36 Faces: The History, Astrology and Magic of the Decans

pointers.locus: the chapter on this decan, in zodiacal order
pointers.why: A chapter per decan, drawing its images from the Picatrix and older lists, beside its planetary ruler and Golden Dawn card.

works.author: Chris Brennan
works.title: Hellenistic Astrology: The Study of Fate and Fortune

pointers.locus: the chapters on the signs and on rulerships
pointers.why: Sets out the sign rulerships, exaltations and triplicities that the graph does not yet carry, and where each comes from.

pointers.locus: the chapters on the planets and on rulerships
pointers.why: The planets as the Hellenistic sources treat them, including the domicile and exaltation schemes.

pointers.locus: Part One, the Major Arcana: the section on this card
pointers.why: A long reading of each trump, card by card, from the Rider-Waite images.

pointers.locus: Part Two, the Minor Arcana: this suit, this card
pointers.why: Each small card and court card in turn, by suit.

works.author: Aleister Crowley
works.title: The Book of Thoth
works.rights: not treated as public domain here (out of copyright in the UK and EU, not clearly so in the US)

pointers.locus: Part II, the Atu: the entry for this trump
pointers.why: Crowley on each trump. Where it differs from Liber 777, notably the Emperor and the Star, it is his later revision.

works.author: Richard Wilhelm, tr. Cary F. Baynes
works.title: The I Ching or Book of Changes
works.publisher: Princeton University Press, Bollingen Series XIX

pointers.locus: Book I, the Text: this hexagram
pointers.why: Wilhelm's commentary on the judgement, image and each line, the reading most English speakers know.

pointers.locus: the Introduction, on the eight trigrams
pointers.why: The trigrams with their images, family members and attributes, as Wilhelm arranges them.

works.author: John Michael Greer
works.title: The Art and Practice of Geomancy

pointers.locus: the chapter on the sixteen figures: this figure
pointers.why: Each figure with its planet, sign and element as the Renaissance manuals give them, and how it is read.

works.author: Joseph H. Peterson, ed.
works.title: The Lesser Key of Solomon
works.rights: in copyright (the edition; the underlying manuscripts are old)

pointers.locus: the Goetia: the entry under this spirit's name
pointers.why: A critical edition of the Goetia with the seals Scot does not print. A different book: its list and order differ from Scot's.

works.author: Joscelyn Godwin
works.title: Harmonies of Heaven and Earth
works.publisher: Thames and Hudson; later Inner Traditions

pointers.locus: the part on the harmony of the spheres
pointers.why: How the planets, modes and Muses were tied to intervals from Pythagoras to Kepler, the tradition Agrippa's chapter draws on.

works.author: Joscelyn Godwin, ed.
works.title: The Harmony of the Spheres: A Sourcebook of the Pythagorean Tradition in Music

pointers.locus: the readings from antiquity to the Renaissance
pointers.why: Translated passages from the sources behind Agrippa's music, including Boethius and Gafurius, with notes.

pointers.locus: the knowledge lectures on the Tree of Life
pointers.why: The Golden Dawn Tree, its sephiroth, paths and letters, the scheme Liber 777 tabulates.

pointers.locus: Book T and the tarot material
pointers.why: The Golden Dawn attributions of the trumps and small cards, including the decan assignment.

works.author: Lynda Bunnell and Ra Uru Hu
works.title: The Definitive Book of Human Design

pointers.locus: the section on the 64 gates: this gate
pointers.why: The gate names and keynotes that divinatory-os deliberately leaves out, as the system's own source gives them.
